corpus: Synthetic macOS-voice fixtures (workers/r2t2/corpus.json): 20 German + 20 English clips, five-minute German/English runs. No human recordings.
werNote: Unnormalised word error rate (lowercase, punctuation stripped). Digits vs spelled numbers count as errors, which inflates Parakeet (it writes digits).

load.compileCache: ~/Library/Caches/<executable name>/com.apple.e5rt.e5bundlecache/<macOS build>/ (per executable name and OS build; a macOS update recompiles once)
load.offline: All runs executed under sandbox-exec with network denied; loading from local directories needs no network.

memoryMB.note: ANE programs and weights are wired kernel memory owned by aned, not the worker's footprint. 'wired' is the system wired delta on first load in a fresh state; aned keeps programs cached after unload until it needs the memory.

vocabularyBiasing.nemotronGerman: setCustomVocabulary works with the latin bundle; on a rare-name probe it fixed 'Quaschnick'->'quaschnik' (case lost) and left correct names intact.
vocabularyBiasing.parakeetV3: FluidAudio's Parakeet biasing needs an additional CTC keyword-spotter model; not used. Blabber's post-hoc vocabulary correction stays.
